## Frequent Questions

* *What happened to [feature]?*

There are still features missing from FrankerFaceZ v4.0 that were present in v3.0. Unfortunately, a few features are impractical to update on the new version of Twitch's website.

Many features are still planned to return as the developers have time to implement them. There is no schedule of pending features. Features are released immediately upon completion.

* *I've donated, but my badge doesn't show up.*
* *I added an emote to my channel but I don't see it.*

Due to performance problems with our current website, we have to use caching on our API. Because of this, it can take up to half an hour for changes made to badges or emotes to take effect. After waiting, refresh the page and your content should appear. You can also try performing a hard refresh.

* *I don't want the `FFZ Supporter` badge.*

Users can toggle the visibility of their FFZ badges at: [https://www.frankerfacez.com/settings/profile](https://www.frankerfacez.com/settings/profile)

* *I can see my emotes, but someone in chat said they can't.*

Users need FrankerFaceZ installed, or another third-party client that supports FFZ emotes, to see emotes from FrankerFaceZ. Users might also not see newly added emotes, depending on their browser cache and when they last refreshed.

* *There's a stolen emote!*
* *There's an offensive emote!*

Please report any issues with emotes using the `Report Emote` tool on our website. Shift-Click the offending emote to open it's page, and select `Report Emote` in the right side-bar. You'll need to sign in to report an emote.

## Third-party Services

### Sentry

This client uses Sentry.io for automatic error reporting. When an error occurs, a report
is automatically sent to Sentry's API with information about the error and the state of
the client at the time to assist us with reproducing and fixing the issue. We attempt to filter personal information such as API keys from error reports before they
are submitted to Sentry.

To see an example of the submitted data or to opt-out of automatic error reporting, please
view the settings available under `Data Management > Reporting`.

### Link Information

This client does not directly contact third-party APIs and websites when gathering data
for use in rendering rich content embeds and tool-tips. No personal information is sent
to third-party APIs or websites when gathering information.

Clients request link information from our own API, sending only the exact link requested
without any context such as the channel the client is viewing at the time. Our server
makes requests from third-party APIs and websites on the behalf of the client and formats
the data for clients to display.

home.term-syntax.default:
This is a guide to the different term syntax options available. Internally,
FrankerFaceZ converts your highlight and block terms into regular
expressions.


### Types

#### 1. Text

Text has no special behavior. Any characters with special meaning in regular
expressions are escaped.


#### 2. Glob

[Globs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glob_(programming)) provide simple, easy
to write pattern matching with wildcard characters. For example, the glob
`cir*` would match all words starting with the letters `cir`, including just
`cir` by itself. The `*` is a wildcard matching any number of characters.

| Wildcard | Description | Example | Matches | Does Not Match |
| :------: | :---------- | :-----: | :-----: | :------------: |
| `*` | Matches any number of non-space characters, including none. | `cir*` | `cir`, `circle`, `cirFairy`, `circumstance` | `ci`, `sir`, `pizza` |
| `**` | Matches any number of any characters, including none. Unlike a single `*`, this will match space characters. | `hello**!` | `hello!`, `hello, streamer!` |
| `?` | Matches any single character. | `?at` | `cat`, `hat`, `pat` | `at`
| `[abc]` | Matches one character from within the brackets. | `[cp]at` | `cat`, `pat` | `hat`, `at`
| `[a-z]` | Matches one character from the range within the brackets. | `Kappa[0-9]` | `Kappa1`, `Kappa2`, ... `Kappa0` | `Kappa`, `KappaHD`
| `[!abc]` | Matches one character that is *not* within the brackets. | `[!cp]at` | `bat`, `rat`, `hat` | `at`, `cat`, `pat`
| `[!a-z]` | Matches one character that is *not* within the range within the brackets. | `Kappa[!0-9]` | `Kappa?`, `KappaF` | `Kappa`, `Kappa0`, `Kappa4`
| `'{'abc,d?f'}'` | Matches one of the possibilities from a comma-separated list. | `cir'{'no,Fairy'}'` | `cirno`, `cirFairy` | `cir`, `circle`


#### 3. Regex

[Regular Expressions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_expression) are complex
pattern strings used in programming. They are meant for advanced users.

FrankerFaceZ uses your browser's built-in engine for handling regular expressions,
with all the limitations that come with it. Regex terms are packaged into the
generated regular expressions the same as both other modes. You should not and can
not use capture groups.

FrankerFaceZ uses rudimentary logic to ensure your regular expression is not
catastrophically slow, but you should still be careful to avoid slow expressions
as they are run frequently.


### Modes

#### Case Sensitive

This attempts to match your term in a case-sensitive manner. Effectively, this
option disables the `/i` flag on the generated regular expression. Due to
limitations in your browser's regex engine, case insensitivity may not work on
some characters.


#### Match Whole Word

This requires that your term is an entire word. For example, the term `test`
without "Match Whole Word" could just as easily match `testing` or `tested`
as it matches `test`. With "Match Whole Word" enabled, it will **only** match
`test`.

This is done by wrapping the generated regular expression in extra pattern
matchers for non-word characters, such as spaces and punctuation.


#### Highlight Matches

When this is enabled, and the matching setting in [Chat > Filtering > General](~)
is enabled, any matched terms will be highlighted in chat so you can see what
exactly matched your term.

Any matches will not be displayed as emotes, links, etc.

This is a bit slower than not highlighting the match, so you may wish to only use
this when testing and then disable it when you know your term works how you wish.

setting.entry.chat.replies.style.descrip.default: Twitch's default style adds a floating button to the right and displays a notice above messages that are replies. FrankerFaceZ uses an In-Line Chat Action (that can be removed in [Chat > Actions > In-Line](~chat.actions.in_line)) and uses an in-line mention to denote replies.

setting.entry.chat.rich.all-links.default: Display rich content embeds for all links.

setting.entry.chat.rich.all-links.descri.default: *Streamers: Please be aware that this is a potential vector for NSFW imagery via thumbnails, so be mindful when capturing chat with this enabled.*

setting.entry.chat.rich.enabled.descript.default: This displays rich content blocks for things like linked clips and videos.

setting.entry.chat.rich.hide-tokens.default: Hide matching links for rich content.

setting.entry.chat.rich.minimum-level.de.default: Only display rich content embeds on messages posted by users with this level or higher.

setting.entry.chat.rich.want-mid.default: Display larger rich content in chat.

setting.entry.chat.rich.want-mid.descrip.default:
This enables the use of bigger rich content embeds in chat. This is **not** recommended for most users and/or chats.

**Note:** Enabling this may cause chat to scroll at inopportune times due to content loading. Moderators should not use this feature.

setting.entry.chat.rituals.show.default: Display ritual messages such as "User is new here! Say Hello!".

setting.entry.chat.scrollback-length.des.default: Keep up to this many lines in chat. Setting this too high will create lag.

setting.entry.chat.scroller.freeze-requi.default: Require the mouse to be over chat to freeze with a hotkey.

setting.entry.chat.scroller.freeze.descr.default:
Automatically stop chat from scrolling when moving the mouse over it or holding a key.

**Note:** Scrolling up in chat will always prevent automatic scrolling, regardless of this setting.

setting.entry.chat.scroller.hover-delay..default: Chat will only remain frozen due to mouse hovering for this long after the mouse stops moving.

setting.entry.chat.scroller.smooth-scrol.default:
**Note:** This may not behave well depending on your browser. Disable this if you encounter issues.

Smoothly slide new chat messages into view. Speed will increase as necessary to keep up with chat.

setting.entry.chat.shared-chat.style.des.default: This controls the appearance of the pill at the left-side of chat messages when a message is part of a Shared Chat. By default, this is Avatar for moderators and broadcasters and Hidden for everyone else.

setting.entry.chat.shared-chat.username-.default: Display the source channel of a chat message when hovering over the poster's username.

setting.entry.chat.sub-emotes.default: Open Twitch subscription pages by Shift-Clicking emotes when relevant.

setting.entry.chat.subs.compact.default: Display subscription notices in a more compact (classic style) form.

setting.entry.chat.subs.gift-banner.default: Display a banner at the top of chat when a mass gift sub happens.

setting.entry.chat.subs.merge-gifts-visi.default: Expand merged mass sub gift messages by default.

setting.entry.chat.subs.merge-gifts.desc.default:
Merge mass gift subscriptions into a single message, depending on the quantity.
**Note:** Only affects newly gifted subs.

setting.entry.chat.subs.native.default: Display subscription notices using Twitch's native UI.

setting.entry.chat.subs.show.description.default: **Note**: Messages sent with re-subs will always be displayed. This only controls the special "X subscribed!" message.

setting.entry.chat.tab-complete.emotes-w.default: Allow tab-completion of emotes without typing a colon. (:)
This will prevent the tab-completion of usernames without the @ prefix.

setting.entry.chat.tab-complete.matching.default:
1: `ppa` would match `Kappa`

2: `sip` would match `cohhSip` but not `Gossip`

3: `pasta` would match `pastaThat` but not `HoldThat`

setting.entry.chat.tab-complete.prioriti.default: Prioritize favorite emotes at the top.
Prioritize emotes that start with user input.

setting.entry.chat.tab-complete.show-sou.default:
Displays the origin of third-party emotes in the autocomplete popup

`Short` is (FFZ, BetterTTV, 7TV)

`Long` is (FFZ Channel/Global Emotes, BetterTTV Channel/Global Emotes, 7TV Emotes, etc)

setting.entry.chat.timestamp-format.desc.default: Timestamps are formatted using the [Day.js](https://github.com/iamkun/dayjs#readme) library. More details about formatting strings [can be found here](https://github.com/iamkun/dayjs/blob/HEAD/docs/en/API-reference.md#list-of-all-available-formats)

setting.entry.chat.timestamp-size.descri.default: How large should timestamps be, in pixels. Defaults to Font Size if not set.

setting.entry.chat.update-when-loaded.default: Update existing chat messages when loading new data.

setting.entry.chat.update-when-loaded.de.default: This may cause elements in chat to move, so you may wish to disable this when performing moderation.

setting.entry.chat.video-chat.enabled.default: Enable FrankerFaceZ features for Chat on Videos.

setting.entry.chat.video-chat.enabled.de.default: Display FFZ badges, emotes, and other features in Chat on Videos. Moderation features may be unavailable when this is enabled.

setting.entry.chat.viewer-cards.highligh.default: Highlight messages from users with open viewer cards.

setting.entry.chat.width.description.default: How wide chat should be, in pixels. This may be affected by your browser's zoom and font size settings.

setting.entry.clips.layout.big.default: Allow the player to get larger on `clips.twitch.tv` pages.

setting.entry.clips.layout.big.descripti.default: This only affects windows at least 1,200 pixels wide and attempts to make the player and chat replay as large as possible.

setting.entry.directory.following.group-.default: Only show a given hosted channel once in the directory.

setting.entry.directory.following.host-m.default: Display a menu to select which channel to visit when clicking a hosted channel in the directory.

setting.entry.directory.hidden.reveal.default: Reveal hidden entries on mouse hover.

setting.entry.directory.hide-costream-bo.default: Hide border on streams with guest stars.

setting.entry.directory.hide-latest-vide.default: Do not show `Latest Videos` in the Following Directory.

setting.entry.directory.hide-live.default: Do not show the Live indicator on channels that are live.

setting.entry.directory.hide-promoted.default: Do not show Promoted streams in the directory.

setting.entry.directory.hide-recommended.default: Do not show `Recommended Live Channels` in the Following Directory.

setting.entry.directory.hide-viewing-his.default: Do not show `Based on your viewing history` in the Following Directory.

setting.entry.directory.hide-vodcasts.default: Do not show reruns in the directory.

setting.entry.directory.show-flags.default: Display Content Flags on channel cards.

setting.entry.directory.uptime.descripti.default: Display the stream uptime on the channel cards.

setting.entry.directory.wait-flags.default: Hide Thumbnails for all channels until Content Flags have been loaded.

setting.entry.directory.wait-flags.descr.default: We need to load content flags with a separate query, so they aren't immediately available to determine if a given stream should be hidden, or have its thumbnail blurred. This setting will blur ALL thumbnails until after we've finished loading the necessary content flag information, ensuring you don't see a flash of anything you would rather not.

setting.entry.ffz.search.matches-only.default: Hide items that do not match completely when searching.

setting.entry.ffz.show-new-settings.default: Display an indicator on the FFZ Control Center button whenever there are new settings added to FrankerFaceZ.

setting.entry.i18n.debug.capture.descrip.default: Capture all localized strings, including variables and call locations, for the purpose of reporting them to the backend. This is used to add new strings to the translation project. By default, message capture is enabled when running in development mode.

setting.entry.i18n.debug.transform.descr.default: Transform all localized strings to test string coverage as well as length.

setting.entry.i18n.format.date.descripti.default: The default date format. Custom date formats are formated using the [Day.js](https://day.js.org/docs/en/display/format) library.

setting.entry.i18n.format.datetime.descr.default: The default combined date-time format. Custom time formats are formated using the [Day.js](https://day.js.org/docs/en/display/format) library.

setting.entry.i18n.format.time.descripti.default: The default time format. Custom time formats are formated using the [Day.js](https://day.js.org/docs/en/display/format) library.

setting.entry.i18n.locale.description.default: FrankerFaceZ is lovingly translated by volunteers from our community. Thank you. If you're interested in helping to translate FrankerFaceZ, please [join our Discord](https://discord.gg/UrAkGhT) and ask about localization.

setting.entry.layout.display-bits-button.default: By default, this inherits its value from [Chat > Bits and Cheering > Display Bits](~chat.bits_and_cheering)

setting.entry.layout.minimal-navigation..default: Slide the site navigation bar up out of view when it isn't in use.

setting.entry.layout.portrait-invert.default: When in portrait mode, place chat at the top.

setting.entry.layout.portrait-min-chat.default: Use compact chat in Portrait Mode.

setting.entry.layout.portrait-min-chat.d.default: When enabled, this minimizes the chat header and places the chat input box in line with the chat buttons in order to present a more compact chat able to display more lines with limited vertical space.

setting.entry.layout.portrait-threshold..default: This is the Width to Height ratio at which point Portrait Mode will begin to activate.

setting.entry.layout.portrait.descriptio.default: In Portrait Mode, chat will be displayed beneath the player when the window is taller than it is wide.

setting.entry.layout.subtember.default: Allow the Subtember upsell banner to appear.

setting.entry.layout.swap-sidebars.descr.default: Swap navigation and chat to the opposite sides of the window.

setting.entry.layout.theatre-navigation.default: Show the minimized navigation bar when in theatre mode.

setting.entry.layout.theme.global-font.d.default:
Override the font used for the entire Twitch website. The old default font was: `"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif`

Any font available via [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/) can be loaded by prefixing the font name with `google:`.

setting.entry.layout.turbo-cta.default: Allow the Twitch Turbo button to appear.

setting.entry.link-cards.enable.descript.default: When this is enabled and you click a link in chat or whispers, a popup will open with information about the link. This provides the same data as rich link tooltips, but in a form that allows more interaction.

setting.entry.link-cards.use-destination.default: When clicking "Open Link" from a Link Card with this enabled, you will bypass known shorteners and tracking services and go directly to the destination URL.

setting.entry.metadata.clip-download.default: Add a Download button for editors to clip pages.

setting.entry.metadata.clip-download.des.default: This adds a download button beneath the player on clip pages (the main site, not on `clips.twitch.tv`) for broadcasters and their editors.

setting.entry.metadata.featured-follow.d.default: Show a featured follow button with the currently featured users.

setting.entry.metadata.host-button.descr.default: Show a host button with the current hosted channel in the tooltip.

setting.entry.metadata.player-stats.desc.default: Show the current stream delay, with playback rate and dropped frames in the tooltip.

setting.entry.metadata.stream-delay-warn.default: When the current stream delay exceeds this number of seconds, display the stream delay in a warning color to draw attention to the large delay. Set to zero to disable.

setting.entry.metadata.uptime.no-native..default: By default, this is enabled whenever FFZ's own Stream Uptime display is enabled to avoid redundant information.

setting.entry.metadata.viewers.descripti.default: This displays the current channel's viewer count without an animation when it changes.

setting.entry.metadata.viewers.no-native.default: By default, this is enabled whenever FFZ's own Viewer Count display is enabled to avoid redundant information.

setting.entry.player.allow-catchup.default: Allow the player to speed up to reduce delay.

setting.entry.player.allow-catchup.descr.default: Twitch, by default, will apply a minor speed up to live video when you have a large delay to the broadcaster in order to catch back up with the live broadcast. This may result in audio distortion. Disable this to prevent the automatic speed changes.

setting.entry.player.button.pip.default: Add a `Picture-in-Picture` button to the player controls.

setting.entry.player.button.pip.descript.default: Clicking the PiP button attempts to toggle Picture-in-Picture mode for the player's video.

setting.entry.player.button.reset.default: Add a `Reset Player` button to the player controls.

setting.entry.player.button.reset.descri.default: Double-clicking the Reset Player button attempts to reset the Twitch player's internal state, fixing playback issues without a full page refresh.

setting.entry.player.captions.custom-pos.default: Enable overriding the position and alignment of closed captions.

setting.entry.player.captions.font-famil.default: Override the font used for displaying Closed Captions.

setting.entry.player.captions.font-size..default: How large should captions be. This can be a percentage, such as `10%`, or a pixel value, such as `50px`.

setting.entry.player.captions.horizontal.default: Override the position for Closed Captions. This can be a percentage, such as `10%`, or a pixel value, such as `50px`.

setting.entry.player.captions.vertical.d.default: Override the position for Closed Captions. This can be a percentage, such as `10%`, or a pixel value, such as `50px`.

setting.entry.player.clip-button.custom..default: Add a custom Clip button to the player that better fits the style of the other buttons.

setting.entry.player.clip-button.hide-na.default: By default, this is enabled when using the setting to add a custom Clip button.

setting.entry.player.compressor.attack.d.default:
**Range:** 0 ~ 1

The amount of time, in seconds, required to reduce the gain by 10 dB.

setting.entry.player.compressor.enable.default: Enable the audio compressor and add an `Audio Compressor` button to the player controls.

setting.entry.player.compressor.force-le.default: Force use of legacy browser API.
This setting forces FrankerFaceZ to attempt to use an older browser API to create the compressor. Please reset your player after changing this setting.

setting.entry.player.compressor.knee.des.default:
**Range:** 0 ~ 40

A decibel value representing the range above the threshold where the curve smoothly transitions to the compressed portion.

setting.entry.player.compressor.ratio.de.default:
**Range:** 0 ~ 20

The amount of change, in dB, needed in the input for a 1 dB change in the output.

setting.entry.player.compressor.release..default:
**Range:** 0 ~ 1
The amount of time, in seconds, required to increase the gain by 10 dB.

setting.entry.player.compressor.shortcut.default: This key sequence can be used to toggle the compressor.

setting.entry.player.compressor.threshol.default:
**Range:** -100 ~ 0

The decibel value above which the compression will start taking effect.

setting.entry.player.disable-content-war.default: When this is enabled, FFZ will automatically skip content warnings. This feature is intended for use by adults only.

setting.entry.player.embed-metadata.default: Show metadata when mousing over the player.

setting.entry.player.ext-hide.descriptio.default: **Note**: This feature does not prevent extensions from loading. Hidden extensions are merely invisible. Hiding extensions with this feature will not improve your security. To prevent extensions from loading entirely, we recommend using the [Disable Twitch Extensions browser extension](https://twitch-tools.rootonline.de/disable_twitch_extensions.php) by CommanderRoot.

setting.entry.player.ext-interaction.default: Allow mouse interaction with overlay extensions.

setting.entry.player.fade-pause-buffer.default: Fade the player when paused or buffering to make the UI easier to see.

setting.entry.player.fullscreen.auto-cha.default: Automatically expand chat when entering fullscreen mode.

setting.entry.player.gain.default.descri.default: The default value for gain control, when gain control is enabled. 100% means no change in volume.

setting.entry.player.gain.enable.default: Enable gain control when the audio compressor is enabled.

setting.entry.player.gain.max.descriptio.default:
**Range:** 100 ~ 1000

The maximum allowed value for gain control. 100% is no change. 200% is double the volume.

setting.entry.player.gain.min.descriptio.default:
**Range:** 0 ~ 100

The minimum allowed value for gain control. 0% is effectively muted.

setting.entry.player.gain.no-volume.default: Force built-in volume to 100% when the audio compressor is enabled.

setting.entry.player.gain.no-volume.desc.default: With this enabled, the built-in volume will be hidden and the Gain Control will be the only way to change volume.

setting.entry.player.gain.scroll.descrip.default: Adjust the gain by scrolling with the mouse wheel. This setting takes precedence over adjusting the volume by scrolling. *This setting will not work properly on streams with visible extensions when mouse interaction with extensions is allowed.*

setting.entry.player.hide-event-bar.desc.default: Hide the Event Bar which appears above the player when there is an ongoing event for the current channel.

setting.entry.player.hide-mouse.default: Hide mouse when controls aren't visible.

setting.entry.player.hide-rerun-bar.desc.default: Hide the Rerun Bar which appears above the player when the current channel is playing a video rather than live content.

setting.entry.player.home.autoplay.default: Auto-play featured broadcasters on the front page.

setting.entry.player.mute-click.default: Mute or unmute the player by middle-clicking.

setting.entry.player.no-autoplay.default: Do not automatically start playing videos or streams.

setting.entry.player.no-autoplay.descrip.default: Note: This feature does not apply when navigating directly from channel to channel.

setting.entry.player.theatre.auto-enter.default: Automatically open Theatre Mode when visiting a channel.

setting.entry.player.theatre.metadata.default: Show metadata when mousing over the player.

setting.entry.player.theatre.no-whispers.default: Hide whispers when Theatre Mode is enabled.

setting.entry.player.vod.autoplay.default: Auto-play the next recommended video after a video finishes.

setting.entry.player.volume-always-shown.default: Keep the volume slider expanded at all times.

setting.entry.player.volume-scroll.default: Adjust volume by scrolling with the mouse wheel.

setting.entry.player.volume-scroll-steps.default: How much the volume level is changed per individual scroll input.

setting.entry.player.volume-scroll.descr.default: *This setting will not work properly on streams with visible extensions when mouse interaction with extensions is allowed.*

setting.entry.pubsub.enabled.description.default: Whether or not you want your client to connect to FrankerFaceZ's PubSub system. This is still in testing and should be left alone unless you know what you're doing.

setting.entry.reports.error.enable.default: Automatically send reports when an error occurs.

setting.entry.reports.error.include-sett.default: Include a settings snapshot in reports.
Knowing exactly what settings are in effect when an error happens can be incredibly useful for recreating the issue.

setting.entry.reports.error.include-user.default: Occasionally, it's useful to know which users are encountering issues so that we can check for specific badges, emote sets, or user flags that are causing issues.

setting.entry.socket.use-cluster.descrip.default: Which server cluster to connect to. Do not change this unless you are actually doing development work on the socket server backend. Doing so will break all features relying on the socket server, including emote information lookups, link tooltips, and live data updates.

setting.entry.sub-button.prime-notice.de.default: Display a crown on subscription buttons when your free channel sub with Prime is available.

setting.entry.theme.color.accent.descrip.default: The accent color is used for buttons, links, etc.

setting.entry.theme.color.background.des.default: Try `#0E0C13` for something close to the old dark theme, or `#0E0E0E` for a nice dark gray. Transparent colors not allowed.

setting.entry.theme.color.chat-accent.de.default: The accent color is used for buttons, links, etc.

setting.entry.theme.color.chat-text.desc.default: If not set, this will automatically be set to white or black based on the brightness of the background.

setting.entry.theme.color.text.descripti.default: If not set, this will automatically be set to white or black based on the brightness of the background.

setting.entry.theme.color.tooltip.backgr.default: If not set, the tooltip settings will be automatically adjusted based on the brightness of the background.

setting.entry.theme.dark.description.default:
*Requires Dark Theme to be Enabled.*

This setting will be going away very soon, as the new theme system matures.
The CSS loaded by this setting is far too heavy and can cause performance issues.

setting.entry.theme.disable-auto-dark.de.default: Enabling this will attempt to disable a browser's built-in automatic dark theme conversion for websites, which is unnecessary on Twitch and can cause display issues. This may not apply depending on your web browser and settings.

setting.entry.theme.disable-high-contras.default: Disable Forced Color / OS High Contrast
Enabling this will instruct your browser to not respect your operating system's High Contrast settings when displaying Twitch. You may need to refresh for this to take full effect.

setting.entry.theme.font.size.descriptio.default:
**Minimum:** `6`, **Maximum:** `25`, *Old Default:* `13`

How large should normal text be, in pixels. This may be affected by your browser's zoom and font settings.

setting.entry.theme.high-contrast-tweaks.default: Enable the use of High Contrast tweaks.
This loads an additional set of styles when Forced Color / OS High Contrast mode is enabled to ensure page elements are displayed more appropriately.

setting.entry.theme.legacy-dark-input.default: Use old input element colors with dark theme.

setting.entry.tooltip.emote-images.anima.default: If this is not overridden, animated images are only shown in emote tool-tips if [Chat > Appearance >> Emotes > Animated Emotes](~chat.appearance.emotes) is not disabled.

setting.entry.tooltip.link-interaction.default: Allow interaction with supported link tooltips.

setting.entry.tooltip.link-nsfw-images.d.default: When enabled, FrankerFaceZ will include images that are tagged as unsafe or that are not rated.

setting.experiments.about.default: This feature allows you to override experiment values. Please note that, for most experiments, you may have to refresh the page for your changes to take effect.

setting.filter.add-default-tip.default: Add all of the default values to this profile.

setting.filter.delete-all.default: Delete all of this profile's entries.

setting.filter.monitor.about.default: This setting requires that this site has the Window Management permission. Please be sure that it is allowed.

setting.filters.if.fail.default: This branch is active because the condition is false.

setting.filters.if.no_fail.default: This branch is not active because the condition is true.

setting.filters.if.no_pass.default: This branch is not active because the condition is false.

setting.filters.if.pass.default: This branch is active because the condition is true.

setting.filters.missing.default: This rule of type "{type}" cannot be loaded. It may be from an add-on that is not loaded.

setting.inheritance.desc.default: Inherit values from lower priority profiles or the default values at this position.

setting.inheritance.skip.desc.default: This profile does not inherit values from lower priority profiles or the default values, despite having no values of its own.

setting.new-line.desc.default: Place all items following this on a new line.

setting.player.compressor.description.default: These settings control optional dynamic range compression for the player, a form of audio processing that reduces the volume of loud sounds and amplifies quiet sounds, thus normalizing or compressing the volume. This uses a [DynamicsCompressorNode](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DynamicsCompressorNode) from the Web Audio API behind the scenes if you want to learn more.

setting.player.compressor.gain_control.d.default: Gain Control gives you extra control over the output volume when using the Compressor by letting you adjust the volume after the compressor runs, while the built-in volume slider takes affect before the compressor. This uses a simple [GainNode](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/GainNode) from the Web Audio API, connected in sequence after the DynamicsCompressorNode the Compressor uses.

setting.priorities.about.default: Here, you can change the priorities of different emote providers. Please note that the provider priority (FFZ, etc.) is still secondary to the source priority (personal emotes > room emotes > global emotes).

setting.priorities.delete.default: Delete the priorities in this settings profile.

setting.priorities.drag.default: Drag providers to change their priority.

setting.priorities.none.default: no priorities are defined in this profile

setting.provider.about.default: Here, you can change the storage provider used by FrankerFaceZ when browsing Twitch. You can try this if you're having a problem with your settings not remaining persistent. Please note that you will need to reload any and all Twitch tabs after changing this.

setting.provider.cosb.desc.default: This provider uses an `<iframe>` to synchronize storage across subdomains. Due to the `<iframe>`, this provider takes longer than others to load, but should perform roughly the same once loaded. You should be using this on non-www subdomains of Twitch unless you don't want your settings to automatically synchronize for some reason.

setting.provider.cross-origin.about.default: This means that your settings will work across different domains, subdomains, and embeds.

setting.provider.ext.desc.default: This provider uses a browser extension service worker to store settings in a location that should not suffer from issues due to storage partitioning or cache clearing.

setting.provider.has-blobs.about.default: This provider supports binary data such as custom sound files.

setting.provider.has-data.about.default: This provider has data saved in it.

setting.provider.idb.desc.default: [IndexedDB](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API) is available on most platforms, and has a slightly slower initialization time than Local Storage. IndexedDB has a higher storage capacity and is less likely to be cleared unexpectedly.

setting.provider.local.desc.default: [Local Storage](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Storage_API) is available on all platforms and fast to access, but has poorly defined capacity limits and may be cleared unexpectedly. Particularly, clearing cookies and cache in your browser will likely clear Local Storage as well.

setting.provider.no-transfer.default: Automatically transfering settings from your current provider to the selected provider is not allowed. Please use Backup and Restore.

setting.provider.selected.about.default: This is the currently active settings provider.

setting.provider.transfer.default: Transfer my settings when switching provider.

setting.provider.transfer.desc.default: **Note:** It is recommended to leave this enabled unless you know what you're doing.

setting.provider.transfer.warning.default: The provider you selected contains data, and that data will be lost if you transfer the data from your current provider to it. Make sure you have a backup of your settings in case anything goes wrong.

setting.provider.warn-domain.desc.default: You are currently changing settings for a sub-domain of Twitch. Any changes here will only affect this sub-domain. You probably want to change this from Twitch's main website, and not here.

setting.provider.warn.desc.default: Please close any other Twitch tabs before using this tool. It is **recommended to [create a backup](~data_management.backup_and_restore)** before changing your provider, in case anything happens.
